import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read and aggregate the CSV to one revenue value per month and region.
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/sales.csv')
grouped = df.groupby(['month', 'region'], as_index=False)['revenue'].sum()
wide = grouped.pivot(index='month', columns='region', values='revenue').fillna(0)
wide = wide.sort_index()

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
ax.stackplot(wide.index, [wide[c].values for c in wide.columns], labels=wide.columns)
ax.set_title('Revenue by Month and Region')
ax.set_xlabel('Month')
ax.set_ylabel('Revenue')
ax.set_ylim(bottom=0)
ax.legend(title='Region')
ax.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.25)
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
